# Winnetka Dental Arts

> General and cosmetic dentistry in Winnetka, Illinois (Chicago's North Shore). Dr. George F. Warga, DDS, has been in private practice for over 30 years, with an emphasis on prosthetics, implants, cosmetics, TMJ, restorative dentistry and occlusal (bite) function. The practice also offers sleep apnea appliances, Invisalign, and Botox for therapeutic and cosmetic facial treatments.

- Address: 570 Lincoln Ave Ste 3, Winnetka, IL 60093 (lower level of the Winnetka Galleria Building)
- Phone (call or text): (847) 441-6510
- Email: info@wargadds.com
- Hours: Monday-Wednesday 6:00 AM-4:00 PM, Thursday 6:00 AM-2:00 PM, closed Friday-Sunday
- Appointment requests: https://www.winnetkadentalarts.com/contact/
